title: Concurrent website research shares one native picture decoder across host adapters and logos
steps: Run the media-info tests with five concurrent picture measurements across two adapters, a blocked feature reader, logo extraction, malformed inputs and feature failures.
expect: At most one native picture measurement enters its feature reader at a time across adapters.
Logo extraction waits for the same permit; malformed images and optional feature errors release it.
Original bytes, orientation, dimensions, palette and features retain their existing values.
fence: one process-wide native image permit held through optional host picture features and shared with logo decoding

tests: native picture measurement is bounded across adapters while preserving input and features
malformed images and failed optional features release the native image permit
logo decoding waits for a picture feature decoder to finish
